from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from downloads import resolve_download

with TemporaryDirectory(dir='.', prefix='download-check-') as tmp:
    base = Path(tmp).resolve()
    root = base / 'root'
    root.mkdir()
    sibling = base / 'root-extra'
    sibling.mkdir()
    (root / 'nested').mkdir()
    (root / 'file.txt').write_text('unchanged')
    (sibling / 'outside.txt').write_text('outside')
    (root / 'inside-link').symlink_to(root / 'nested', target_is_directory=True)
    (root / 'outside-link').symlink_to(sibling, target_is_directory=True)

    def snapshot():
        return sorted((str(p.relative_to(base)), 'link', str(p.readlink())) if p.is_symlink()
                      else (str(p.relative_to(base)), 'dir' if p.is_dir() else 'file',
                            None if p.is_dir() else p.read_bytes())
                      for p in base.rglob('*'))

    before = snapshot()
    accepted = {
        'file.txt': root / 'file.txt',
        'nested/missing.txt': root / 'nested/missing.txt',
        'nested/../file.txt': root / 'file.txt',
        'inside-link/missing.txt': root / 'nested/missing.txt',
        '.': root,
        '': root,
    }
    for name, expected in accepted.items():
        actual = resolve_download(root, name)
        assert isinstance(actual, Path) and actual == expected, (name, actual)
    rejected = [str(root / 'file.txt'), str(root), str(sibling / 'outside.txt'),
                '../root-extra/outside.txt', '../missing.txt',
                'outside-link/outside.txt', 'outside-link/missing.txt']
    for name in rejected:
        try:
            resolve_download(root, name)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f'accepted {name"'!r}'"')
    assert snapshot() == before, 'resolver changed filesystem contents'
    print(f'Passed {len(accepted)} accepted and {len(rejected)} rejected cases; filesystem snapshot unchanged.')
